situation: metadata 缺失或損壞，無法可靠還原

Preserve <file> and run log <path>. If the metadata was committed to Git, restore it from Git and retry. Otherwise, report the issue at https://github.com/ycpss91255-research/vendor_kit/issues and attach both files.
description: 無法處理 <file>：metadata 缺失或損壞，無法可靠還原。vendor_kit 不以推測代替紀錄，除執行紀錄外，未修改任何檔。請先保留 <file> 與執行紀錄 <path>；metadata 若曾 commit 進 git，從 git 還原後重試；無法還原時，到 https://github.com/ycpss91255-research/vendor_kit/issues 回報，附上這兩個檔。
